ambiguity: More than one admissible candidate without an exact precedence rule is an error, never a best-effort choice.
offline_requirement: A standalone export must resolve all required roots without network access.
path_handling: Paths are materialization destinations or provenance hints only.
remote_requirement: A compact export may reference remote/pinned roots by hash if the export explicitly declares non-standalone mode.
resolution_order: exact logical node materialized from local object store
exact node imported from verified graph export/remote store
deterministically rebuild dependency from a validated recipe
semantic_aliases: Human-readable aliases (e.g. ig:O6/graduated-carrier/v1) resolve to one immutable node identity through a versioned alias record; aliases are never themselves scientific identities.
